Drinking water is easy. Remembering is the hard part. WaterBoy gives you a buddy who notices when you forget.

He's a splash of water living in a round glass on your home screen. He sloshes, blinks, naps, and reacts when you poke him. He starts every morning full, sinks a little with each reminder you let slide, and fills right back up the moment you drink. Keep up and he's cheerful. Ignore him all afternoon and he's a mopey puddle at the bottom of the glass.

LOG A DRINK WITH ONE TAP
A tap is a sip, three sips make a cup, and a cup is 12 oz. Or not: sip size, cup size, sips per cup, and your daily goal are all yours to set. Every drink lands in a day-by-day log.

REMINDERS SHAPED LIKE YOUR DAY

Today stays safe until it's over. Rest days don't count against you. And a single miss is forgiven; it takes two in a row to end a run. The month view shows every day at a glance, plus your best run and average cups.

HYDRATE WITH FRIENDS, IF YOU WANT

PRIVATE BECAUSE THERE'S NOWHERE TO SEND IT
